purpose: Extend the permanent reusable historical library with globally discovered free/open identity, event and tracking sources while preserving the exact N1 2024/25 Big3 deep+PPDA requirement separately.

sources.name: SkillCorner Open Data
sources.notes: Official open repository; current README describes 2024/25 A-League sample matches, tracking, dynamic events and phases of play. Useful for future feature-measurement research, not the locked Big3 cohort.

sources.name: Integrated Dataset of Synchronized Spatiotemporal and Event Data in Elite Soccer
sources.provider: DFL / Sportec Solutions / Figshare mirror by PySport
sources.notes: Scientific Data paper states release under CC BY 4.0 with DFL authorization. Rich synchronized tracking/event data; too small/old for locked N1 Big3 confirmation.

sources.name: football.json / football.db public-domain match data
sources.notes: Schema, data and scripts are dedicated to the public domain. Strong permanent identity/result backbone, but no deep+PPDA.

sources.name: English Premier League 2024/25 SkillCorner
sources.notes: Contact-information gate is required before file access. Catalog only; do not automate acceptance or transmit user identity. Not part of missing Big3.

sources.name: Metrica Sports Sample Data
sources.notes: README invites community use and asks attribution/responsible use, but no explicit standard reuse licence was surfaced. Keep out of permanent ingest under current governance.
